panels.title: Window / coverage
panels.description: Seven elapsed-day presets; exact counts of retained observations only. The cutoff is the previous closed UTC five-minute boundary, not a verified committed collector watermark. Coverage remains unverified; retention, deletions and collector gaps can shorten history. Current-state panels are snapshots. External Prometheus sample retention is independent.
